Corovaner / reusable UI kit

Coffee enamel, aged brass and dark steel. Hover the buttons, toggle the switch, and move the gauge.

Live button states

Ready to travel.

Independent hardware

Survival mode off

The lamp appears on hover or keyboard focus. Labels are live text; the gauge needle and toggle handle move independently.

Stretchable surfaces

Corner hardware stays fixed. Buttons use horizontal stretching; panels also stretch vertically.

Hardware and icons

PNG sprites + SVG icons + LibGDX atlas + nine-patch inputs. See manifest.json for sizes, padding and pivot points.
